info.name: SMemories - class yearbook: classes, memberships and roles (E07, T-026)
info.description: Classes, the two roles and the permission matrix (docs/class-permissions.md). Run against an API started with SMEM_ENV=dev and SMEM_DEV_FIXED_OTP set (.env.example does: 123123), because the flow verifies its two fresh accounts with the dev email code; the session token is read from the register response's Set-Cookie header and sent in an explicit Cookie header, so users A (teacher, admin) and B (not in A's class) act in one run. Each run registers 2 users (the register limit is 5 per hour per IP: run `make reset-limits` before a third run within the hour) and every run uses new accounts, so it can run twice in a row. Run the whole collection in order: the Edge cases folder reuses the users from the Full flow. What it cannot cover yet: members other than the creator (a student, a second admin) need invites (T-125); the student 403s, the roster for several members and the last-admin race with two admins are covered by internal/class/*_integration_test.go and get a Postman step when T-125 lands.

item.name: Full flow
Register user A (teacher)
Verify A's email with the dev code (needs SMEM_DEV_FIXED_OTP)
Register user B (stranger to the class)
B creates a class before verifying the email - 403 ERROR_EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED
Verify B's email with the dev code (needs SMEM_DEV_FIXED_OTP)
A creates a class and becomes its admin
A lists the classes: the new one, as admin

exec: pm.test('the class is listed with my role', () => { const c = d.items.find(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('classId')); pm.expect(c).to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(c.my_role).to.eql('admin'); });

item.name: A reads the class (no roster in the answer)

exec: pm.test('no roster in the class answer', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data).to.not.have.any.keys('members', 'roster', 'students', 'admins'));

item.name: A replaces the class details (the school is cleared)
A reads the roster: one row, A, admin
A, the last admin, cannot leave - 403 ERROR_LAST_ADMIN
A cannot remove self as the last admin - 403 ERROR_LAST_ADMIN
A cannot demote self as the last admin - 403 ERROR_LAST_ADMIN
A sets an unknown role - 400 ERROR_INVALID_ROLE
B (not a member) reads the class - 404, the same as a class that does not exist
B reads a class that does not exist - same 404, same message

exec: pm.test('same message as for a class B is not in', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error_message).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('notFoundMessage')));

item.name: B reads the roster - 404
B updates the class - 404
B deletes the class - 404
B removes A - 404
B promotes A - 404
B leaves a class B is not in - 404
B lists the classes: A's class is not there
B creates a class of their own - any verified user may
A deletes the class
A reads the deleted class - 404

exec: // Folder scripts run before every request in the folder, so generate only before the first one: the whole flow then uses
// one consistent pair of accounts, and every new run gets fresh ones (no collision with data from older runs).

item.name: Edge cases
Create without a session - 401
List without a session - 401
Read a class without a session - 401
Roster without a session - 401
Delete without a session - 401
Leave without a session - 401
Create with an empty name - 400 ERROR_INVALID_NAME
Create with a name of 121 characters - 400 ERROR_INVALID_NAME
Create with a name of exactly 120 characters is fine
Create with an unknown language - 400 ERROR_INVALID_LANGUAGE
Create with a graduation year of 1949 - 400 ERROR_INVALID_GRADUATION_YEAR
Create with an unknown field - 400 ERROR_PARAM
Read a class with a lower-case id - 400 ERROR_PARAM
Read a class with a short id - 400 ERROR_PARAM
Read a class with no id - 400 ERROR_PARAM
List with limit 0 - 400 ERROR_PARAM
List with a made-up next_id - 400 ERROR_PARAM
List one at a time: a page token, and it is refused for another user

exec: pm.test('B has more than one class, so there is a next page', () => pm.expect(d.next_id).to.not.eql(''));

item.name: A uses B's page token - 400 ERROR_PARAM (tokens are bound to the list)
B uses the page token on its own list - 200
B creates the 11th class as admin - 409 ERROR_LIMIT_REACHED

exec: // Fill B's admin slots: create classes one after the other until the API refuses (at most 12 tries), so the request itself is the one over the cap.
